## HueMux v0.0.2-alpha.4 — there is an Android app

> **Alpha, and the Android build is the rawest thing here.** The APK has never
> run on a phone — nothing in the build environment can run an emulator, so
> "it compiles and packages correctly" is the entire extent of what is known
> about it. The desktop binaries are in better shape but still untested beyond
> Linux. For something that has actually been used, stay on
> [v0.0.1](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.1).

### Android

`huemux-v0.0.2-alpha.4-arm64.apk` is attached to this release. It is a debug
build, unsigned for distribution, arm64 only — which covers every current
Android device.

It is not a remote control. **The entire HueMux server runs on the phone**:
pairing, the CLIP v2 client, DTLS, the colour pipeline, favorites, and the
whole web UI, compiled into the app via `gomobile` and hosted in a WebView
pointed at `127.0.0.1`. No server anywhere else, no cloud, nothing to keep
running at home. It is the same trick the desktop build plays with Electron,
and it means the loopback-only security model carries over untouched.

Screen sync is **not** in this build. No mobile browser supports
`getDisplayMedia()`, so capture has to go through Android's native
`MediaProjection`, which is a later milestone. A phone therefore starts in the
lights-only profile.

What to expect when testing:

- **Bridge discovery is the most likely thing to fail.** Android drops
  multicast by default; the app takes a multicast lock to prevent that, but
  some OEM ROMs filter it regardless. Manual IP entry is on the pairing screen
  as a fallback, and works.
- Pairing, rooms, lights, scenes, and favorites should all behave as they do
  on the desktop, because they are literally the same code.

### Also

- The pairing panel is now shared by both pages, so a lights-only install can
  pair on its own — see
  [alpha.3](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/releases/tag/v0.0.2-alpha.3).
- Releases now carry the APK alongside the desktop binaries, and its checksum
  is in `SHA256SUMS` with everything else.

### Still not wired up

`--listen-host`, `--auth`, `--token`, `--tls` remain parsed and validated but
inert; the server binds `127.0.0.1` only. Profiles gate the server but not yet
the UI, so both tabs still appear regardless. See
[plans/03-execution-phases.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/plans/03-execution-phases.md).

### Known issues

Unchanged for desktop — see
[KNOWN_ISSUES.md](https://github.com/zamber/huemux/blob/main/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).
Nothing is known about Android yet, which is the point of this release.
